name: 34994 · Stuart, FL
findings: ZIP 34994 (Stuart) has 132 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34994 (Stuart) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 34994 (Stuart) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
